translation: I could help my brother by looking at all the different ways of communicating that are available and seeing which ones are more expensive and which ones cost less, because sometimes you find that you cannot use all of these different methods of communication. You may be able to use all of them, but you cannot use them all at the same time if they are going to cost you too much. So, if my brother came to me and I could see that he was not in a good situation, I would advise him to choose methods of communication that would not cost him too much, such as, for example, messaging apps. At the moment, if you look at it, using messaging apps allows you to communicate with someone more often and more quickly. Whereas sometimes, when you do things like phone calls, calling someone and speaking to them and hearing their voice can end up costing you a lot more. But nowadays, with technology, we have what we call messaging apps. These make it possible for someone to communicate with the person they want to communicate with, even when they sometimes do not have enough money. Another thing would be to look at the different telecommunications companies, because their costs or prices are not the same. They differ. I would then help him choose a company or a method of communication that suits his budget and what he can afford.
